{{Top|leg}}
The '''Grand Dining Room''' was located on the [[Lido Deck]] of the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. Formal wear was required for entry, and [[Head Chef]] [[Chirome]] prepared the meals served in the Grand Dining Room, including the [[Filet of Coslen Dantoinal]].
